latestVersion.changelog:
AI Video Frames Skill v1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Extracts and exports video frames from user-uploaded clips via a simple chat interface.
- Automatic backend setup: authenticates with cloud GPU render pipeline and manages sessions.
- Supports intuitive prompts for actions like frame extraction, format export, audio/text overlays, and credits inquiry.
- Handles popular video/audio/image formats up to 1080p and 500MB.
- Provides clear error handling and progress feedback.
- Designed for fast turnaround (20–40 seconds for short clips) with no manual export settings required.
